web_test_names: 204 approval/cancellation is an explicit successful empty response
a retained proof cannot be replaced, including before an approval retry
a separately selected reapproval proof never overwrites the original submitted request
a stale reapproval attempt does not block a new explicit decision for the original device
authority export retains the host account and exact revision without selecting a current roster
historical issuance stays byte-exact and does not select its own current roster
malformed successful responses and oversized bodies do not become success
plain-text body rejection remains a failure with its actual status
reapproval retry retains the explicitly selected u64 predecessor and original request
recovery file merge is bounded, scope-bound and idempotent
request encodings reject noncanonical padding, trailing bits and oversized data
status does not silently follow a historical successor or create another grant
storage failure before send prevents HTTP; failed response save retains the original pending record
transport retains exact response text and sends u64 values without rounding
u64 integers remain exact through parsing, request encoding and recovery storage
unknown invitation response retains its original correlation across a new model
wrong-account responses, corrupt storage and conflicting imports never reset original records
